title: Kotlin Reflection on the JVM
learning_outcomes: Explain the central rule or purpose of kotlin reflection on the jvm using at least one correct term from the lesson.
Interpret or adapt a small Kotlin example that demonstrates kotlin reflection on the jvm.
Identify one relevant edge case, debugging step, or version/platform constraint.

content.intro: In this lesson, you will learn **Kotlin Reflection on the JVM** as part of **Annotations, Reflection, and Code Generation**. Kotlin and Java interoperate, but platform types, annotations, generated JVM signatures, and collection mutability require explicit boundary checks. Use the subtopics—The kotlin-reflect Dependency, Discovering Members and Types, Reflection Limitations and Costs—as a checklist: predict what the example will do, then verify it in a project configured for the target platform.
content.why_it_matters: Professional applications need repeatable tests, clear APIs, dependable dependencies, security checks, and observable failures. Apply this concept in small steps before integrating it into a larger project.
